verdict.rationale: Hightouch documents an official MCP server that connects a user's AI assistant to the platform. The documented tool surface covers building audiences, managing and creating syncs, designing and analyzing journeys, and generating ad creatives, with plain-language example prompts. missing for 10: documented connection/authentication setup steps for MCP clients, independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP server working.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: the Hightouch MCP server connects your AI assistant directly to your marketing stack so your team can build audiences, manage syncs, design journeys, generate emails and ads, and analyze performance — all in plain language.
All customers: Understand your customer schema, build audiences, create and analyze journeys, manage syncs, and create syncs from templates.
Ad Studio Customers: Generate visual ad creatives from a prompt, refine them with follow-up instructions, and browse existing projects.
